# OneToolBox — Free Online Browser Utilities

> OneToolBox (https://onetoolbox.dev) is a 100% private, client-side suite of online web utilities for developers, designers, creators, and professionals. All processing happens locally in the user's browser with zero server uploads, zero logs, and zero tracking.

## Core Features & Privacy Model
- 100% Client-Side Computation: Powered by native Web Cryptography API, HTML5 Canvas, and modern ES6 JavaScript.
- Zero Server Data Collection: Files, images, JSON payloads, and text never leave the user's browser.
- Instant Zero Latency: Operates offline after initial page load without network round-trips.
- Completely Free: No user registration, no account creation, no sign-up, and no watermarks.

## Tool Directory by Category

### Developer Tools
- [JSON Viewer](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/json-viewer): Interactive collapsible tree view inspector and syntax highlighter for complex nested JSON.
- [JSON Formatter](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/json-formatter): Beautify, format, validate, and minify JSON with custom 2-space, 4-space, or tab indentation.
- [UUID Generator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/uuid-generator): Generate cryptographically secure Version 4 UUIDs (GUIDs) in bulk.
- [HTML Encoder](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/html-encoder): Convert special characters (&, <, >) to HTML entities and unescape markup safely.
- [CSS Minifier](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/css-minifier): Compress stylesheet payload sizes by stripping comments and whitespace.
- [JS Minifier](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/js-minifier): Compress JavaScript code payload sizes for production deployment.
- [YAML Validator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/yaml-validator): Validate, parse, and convert YAML to JSON with real-time error reporting and line-level error diagnostics.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/svg-optimizer): Clean, compress, and minify SVG vector code by removing metadata, comments, and whitespace.
- [Hash Generator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/hash-generator): Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 cryptographic hashes for text and files via Web Cryptography API.
- [Text Diff](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/text-diff): Compare two text files or code snippets side-by-side to highlight additions, deletions, and modifications line by line.
- [Color Converter](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/color-converter): Convert HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, and CMYK color codes with color picker, contrast check, and palette generator.

### Image Tools
- [Image Compressor](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/image-compressor): 100% private browser HTML5 Canvas image optimization for PNG, JPG, and WebP.
- [WebP Converter](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/webp-converter): Convert PNG and JPG photos to next-gen Google WebP image format.
- [PNG to JPG](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/png-to-jpg): Convert transparent PNG graphics to JPG standard format with custom background fill colors.
- [JPG to PNG](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/jpg-to-png): Convert lossy JPEG photos to lossless PNG graphics.
- [Favicon Generator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/favicon-generator): Convert any logo or picture into multi-size favicons (16x16, 32x32, Apple Touch, PWA app icons).
- [Image Resizer](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/image-resizer): Resize PNG, JPG, and WebP images by width, height, or percentage client-side.

### Text Utilities
- [Markdown Previewer](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/markdown-preview): Live side-by-side GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) editor and HTML converter.
- [Base64 Encoder](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/base64-encoder): Convert plain text into standard or URL-safe Base64 strings.
- [Base64 Decoder](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/base64-decoder): Decode Base64 encoded strings back into plain UTF-8 text with auto-validation.

### Calculators & Converters
- [Age Calculator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/age-calculator): Compute exact age down to minutes, total days lived, and next birthday countdown.
- [Password Generator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/password-generator): CSPRNG hardware-random password creator with customizable rules and entropy meter.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix epoch timestamps (seconds/ms) to UTC/local dates and ISO strings.

### Social Media Tools
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/youtube-thumbnail-downloader): Extract 4K (1080p), HD (720p), and SD YouTube video cover images.
- [QR Code Generator](https://onetoolbox.dev/tools/qr-code-generator): Generate custom vector & PNG QR codes for website URLs, text, and Wi-Fi.
